services.name: Girdwood Campground
services.desc: ​​​​The Girdwood Tent Campground is open​.​ The Girdwood Tent Campground is typically open late-May thru mid-September, depending upon weather.There is no vehicle, camper, RV or trailer camp​ing at the Girdwood Tent Campground.​Girdwood Parks and Recreation offers tent camping opportunities during the summer months at the Girdwood Campground. To reach the campground, take Alyeska Highway and turn east on Egloff Drive. Follow Egloff Drive past the Glacier City Hall building, Girdwood Fire Department and Ball Field.
